goal: Investigate intermittent MV2C LP runtime request budget failures, reduce unnecessary read work, and verify partial failure and automatic recovery.
rootCause: Not confirmed. The observed production error did not recur in this sampling window; inefficient reads are verified contributors to request consumption, not proof of the failing invocation.
changes: Reuse the SDK pool entity from state validation for LP fee preview; retain its Airlock initializer binding, discovery behavior, SDK math, and the original public state() result shape.
Increase bounded feed-proposal read groups from 8 to the existing transport batch ceiling of 20.
Log partial preview failures once per pool/status refresh using block, public addresses and fixed safe diagnostic categories; never raw RPC exceptions or URLs.

productionObservation.limits: Live tail only, not historical log search. Existing source catches preview errors without logging them, so outcome=ok and no exceptions alone do not prove healthy previews or establish failure frequency.

liveRpcMeasurement.scope: Actual Robinhood RPC reads in local Node; public config/token metadata snapshot; excludes display config/store HTTP and Cloudflare execution
liveRpcMeasurement.results: Both runs returned LP and Hook zero for all five pools. HTTP count fell 25 to 22 and method count 51 to 46 in these runs.
liveRpcMeasurement.limits: Actual read-only mainnet RPC in local Node using the same public metadata snapshot. Excludes config/store HTTP, Cloudflare invocation overhead, concurrent users, and retry storms. Measurements are not a per-invocation production budget guarantee.

boundaries: Synthetic budget fixture is not Cloudflare runtime reproduction.
The concurrent full preview may not save an HTTP fetch from entity reuse alone; the combined live measurement includes feed grouping.
Disabled button assertions do not establish that partial preview failure itself disables operations.

unchanged: No deployment, commit, push, production migration, runtime permission change, wallet connection, signature, transaction, keeper restart, paid service or request-limit increase.
Existing partial-result null-versus-zero behavior and status cache/backoff/polling policy retained.
remaining: Deploy the reviewed read-only changes through the existing release pipeline when authorized, then correlate buyback_fee_preview_failure events with fresh API snapshots. A later healthy sample alone cannot establish that the intermittent root cause is eliminated.

followup20261106.newObservation: Owner reports 08:01 automatic refresh: MV2C COST and MV2C both LP and Hook runtime budget failures; other pools healthy; ordinary refresh later recovers. Original failing response and exact block were not captured by this investigation.

historicalLogAccess.result: Existing OAuth token cannot query historical observability; no scopes or security controls changed. Dashboard was behind security verification; no bypass attempted.

confirmedFindings: Previous local measurement excluded config/store fetches. Five pools independently queried store.token despite an already filtered catalog snapshot.
Separate storage waits prevent some SDK reads from sharing HTTP batches, so removing catalog re-reads can also reduce RPC fetches.
Partial snapshots retain the existing 120-second server TTL; ordinary reload does not itself invalidate that cache. Recovery must be compared by readId, checkedAt, cacheExpiresAt and blockNumber.
Manual refresh previously cleared every pool before its request completed.
changes: Pass the already filtered catalog TokenRecord to preview while retaining chain, locked state, quote asset, pool ID and fee-engine checks.
Give each fresh engine read a readId; preserve it on cache/inFlight/failure and expose X-Buyback-Read-Id for correlation.
Log RPC/storage fetch attempts, method attempts/retries, 429/budget rejections, phase and concurrency counts with the same readId and snapshot block.
Log late I/O separately with the original readId after fail-fast completion, without waiting or changing retries.
Keep healthy values and source time during ordinary manual refresh; preserve the existing no-processing gate until replacement finishes.

measurement.scope: Actual mainnet RPC and production storage GETs from local Node. Full fresh reader/config/catalog/pool path; only GET and the existing read-only nft guard introspection RPC allowed; all other non-GET calls blocked before I/O. Not Cloudflare quota measurement.

followup20261106.diagnosticBoundary: Application dispatches within one fresh read, not Cloudflare internal quota or all simultaneous DO events. HTTP batches belong to the dispatch context; method attempts belong to the initiating context. Shared external work can belong to another scope. Completion counts exclude later dispatches, which are separate late_io logs. No raw URL, header, body, key or raw error is logged.

validation.workerd: Real workerd validated ALS across two DO requests, parallel read scopes and nested phases with mocked upstream; Node tests also cover fail-fast late I/O. Does not reproduce a live quota limit.
validation.review: Independent read-only review found no blocker; no permissions, signing, transaction or cache-TTL change.

followup20261106.remainingUncertainty: Root cause and long-term frequency remain unconfirmed. Full-path Node measurements are not evidence of the production limit or the 08:01 invocation. New live logs must correlate a recurrence before asserting causality.
